card.name: French "de" and "du" in titles
card.fires_on: The French word "de", "du" or "au" inside French titles and names, right after a noun. Also the "DU"/"AU" glued to a drug brand name in a contraindications heading.

modes.label: Drug heading
modes.description: "DU" or "AU" fused to the start of an upper-case brand name after the CONTRAINDICATIONS heading.

modes.label: French title
modes.description: "de" after a noun in French book titles, place names or organisation names in English text.
